# UniSpike_Acceleration

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A hardware-software co-design approach for accelerating spiking neural networks on neuromorphic chips, optimizing spike timing and resource utilization. Directly addresses the latency and throughput bottlenecks in neuromorphic deployment, making SNNs practical for real-time edge applications.
